|translation='''Title:''' Rogue 3.

'''Card text:'''
May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Wedge is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

'''Lore:'''
Enclosed. Commander Wedge Antilles pilots it. It succeeded in tangling a walker's legs. Abandoned when the Rebels evacuated Echo Base.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says it succeeded in tangling a walker's legs rather than “Successful walker tripper”, and uses 中佐.
